title: Rejects quantity above maximum
objective: Verify that a quantity of max+1 is rejected with a validation error
preconditions: User is authenticated; product P-1 exists with max quantity 10
steps: 1. Open product P-1 | 2. Enter quantity 11 | 3. Click Add to cart
expected_result: Item is not added; message 'Maximum quantity is 10' is shown; cart total unchanged
